title: m68000 M7: full TomHarte coverage + optional MAME cross-validation
description: Widen TomHarte 680x0 skip-list to full coverage; resolve remaining diffs. Optional: MAME 68000 cross-validation shim under cross-validation/m68000_0148/ mirroring m6809 shim as a secondary oracle.
notes: Decision (2026-06-10): MAME 0.148 cross-validation dropped for the m68000. TomHarte is the stronger oracle: hardware-verified state vectors incl. undefined flags, plus cycle counts and per-cycle bus transactions (length/transactions fields, currently unused) if cycle-accurate timing validation is ever wanted. MAME 0.148 is demonstrably weaker on exactly the interesting cases (SBCD/NBCD V approximation, ASR past-width C/X, DIVU/DIVS overflow flags), so every comparison mask would be 'phosphor right, MAME wrong'. Remaining M7 scope: widen skip-list to full coverage once M3-M5 land.

title: m68000: flags & SR model

Per-CPU set_flag/flag_is_set wrappers delegating to cpu::flags::set_flag. interrupt_mask()/set_interrupt_mask(). set_supervisor(on) swapping a[7] with usp/ssp on S-bit change. cc_true() condition-code evaluator for Bcc/Scc/DBcc. Document X-flag semantics. Unit tests for SP-swap and cc_true.
close_reason: SrFlag enum, u16 shared flag helpers, interrupt mask accessors, set_supervisor SP-swap, cc_true evaluator, 12 unit tests

Critical: (An)+/-(An) timing, A7-byte-adjusts-by-2, An word sign-extension, Dn byte/word preserves upper bits. Heavy unit tests.
